title: Bus Tracking System
subtitle: Smart Bus Arrival Information Display for Rural Bus Stops

problem.title: Lack of Bus Tracking Information in Rural Areas
problem.description: Many rural bus stops do not have digital bus tracking systems like CHALO or real-time information displays. Passengers do not know which bus is arriving, its expected arrival time, or possible delays. Students, workers, senior citizens, and daily commuters often spend a long time waiting at bus stops, making it difficult to manage their time and plan their journey.

solution.title: Smart Bus Tracking System
solution.description: A Bus Tracking System is developed using an Arduino UNO and a 3.5-inch TFT Display. The display is installed at a model bus stop and shows the bus number, destination, and expected arrival time. This provides passengers with clear and timely information, helping them plan their travel more efficiently. In a real-world implementation, the display can receive live data from a GPS-enabled bus tracking system.

working.action: The TFT display shows a list of buses arriving at the nearest bus stop.
Each bus is displayed with its route number, destination, and estimated arrival time.
Passengers check the display before boarding the bus.
The displayed information helps passengers plan their journey and reduces unnecessary waiting.
In future, the system can be connected to GPS and the Internet for real-time bus tracking.

benefits: Reduces waiting time at bus stops.
Helps passengers manage their travel time.
Provides bus arrival information at rural bus stops.
Supports students, workers, senior citizens, and daily commuters.
Improves convenience and confidence while using public transport.
Can be upgraded into a real-time smart transportation system.
realLifeApplications: Small towns without digital transport systems
futureScope: Integrate GPS for live bus location tracking.
Connect to the Internet for real-time updates.
Display bus delays and cancellation alerts.
Provide voice announcements for visually impaired passengers.
Develop a mobile application connected to the display.
Power the system using solar energy for remote locations.

impact.community: Makes public transportation more accessible, reliable, and convenient for rural communities.
impact.environment: Encourages the use of public transport, reducing private vehicle usage and fuel consumption.
impact.social: Improves travel planning and saves time for students, workers, and other daily commuters.
